title_as_printed: Osmotic Coefficients for Concentrated NaCl Solutions at High Temperatures

footnotes_as_printed.Note 1: Osmotic coefficients for pressures equal to vapor pressure of pure water at each temperature.

pressure_note: Not stated as total or partial in the table. Osmotic coefficients are 'at p = p0' i.e. 'Osmotic coefficients for pressures equal to vapor pressure of pure water at each temperature' (Table 2 Note 1). Solution vapor pressure = p0 - delta p (delta p measured 'corrected to 0 C' for mercury column, per text).

P.note: p = vapor pressure of pure water at T (builder: IAPWS-95 psat); Table 2 Note 1: osmotic coefficients are for pressures equal to the vapor pressure of pure water at each temperature

extra_unmapped: saturation flag column: '(sat.)' printed beside the concentration marks the saturated solution (concentration at saturation derived by the authors from their own extrapolation, section 5.1.4)
notes: Osmotic coefficients are calculated by the authors from the measured vapor pressure lowering (the raw delta p are NOT tabulated for these concentrations). Printed as two side-by-side column blocks (75-175 C left, 200-300 C right); stacked left block first, then right. Temperature printed once per block; filled down. Hand-written annotations on the scanned page ignored. Concentration at saturation is the authors' derived solubility, not a literature value.
